expected.charges: Federal prosecution under the Espionage Act of 1917 and/or the Sedition Act of 1918 (mass IWW trial in Chicago).
expected.sentence: Twenty years in prison (Espionage/Sedition Act conviction).

updates.convicted: Yes - convicted in the 1917-1918 Chicago mass IWW prosecution.
updates.sentence: Twenty years in prison (Espionage/Sedition Act conviction). A $20,000 fine was also imposed. The prison sentence was commuted in December 1922 on condition of deportation. Source: https://kenyonzimmer.com/red-scare-deportees/reid-to-rivera/
